name: Azuma Himari
source:
Third daughter of the Azuma family and twin sister of Komari. She is a first-year student at St. Orkis Academy. Himari looks nice, but she is selfish and self-indulgent. She is aware of her status as part of the Azuma family and is a tyrant.

[Translated from the [url=http://liquid.nexton-net.jp/17th/seidorei2/]official site[/url]]
